runtime.label: Launcher-ready Fallout 1 V13ENT, New Vegas Goodsprings, and Fallout 3 CG00 slices; no full campaign.

fo1HexTactical.floor: one opaque owned cave mesh over 30196 exact source-backed movement hexes
fo1HexTactical.gridOverlay: optional opaque depth-tested mesh with 29127 walkable hexes and 92428 unique shared edges

vault13Concept.message: Launcher-capable when the player registers generated local hex-scene.json and character-start.json inputs. The route has original-style character creation, the owned Overseer movie with Escape/skip convergence, and one shared V13ENT save across Hex Tactical and First Person. A diagnostic OpenXR adapter reaches that shared session but is not launcher-enabled: reload/save simulator input, XR door use, campaign-native hands/weapon/UI, and physical-headset acceptance remain open. Only 1 of 96 inventoried local maps is tactically playable; dialogue, quests, complete campaign simulation, and retail combat-formula parity are not connected.

arroyo.message: The owned Fallout 2 DAT2 install can be registered, but no MAP/PRO/FRM character flow or Arroyo Temple of Trials runtime slice is transported. Hex, FPS, and OpenXR remain disabled.

jam.message: JAM gameplay semantics are not promoted in the Godot sandbox.

vanilla.message: Launcher-capable with the locally registered Fallout 3 GOTY profile. This bounded route opens a profile-backed menu, plays the locally transcoded and hash-verified owned intro, converges Escape and Skip on the owned CG00 sex/name path, exposes source-backed playable race plus sex-aware hair/eye choices, persists the selected FaceGen defaults at stage 62, and stops before CG00PlayerSection4 because player-package execution and Vault 101 world loading are not connected. The texture preview is not a 3D face render.
